mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with an air quality index of 52. We are under a First Quarter moon, and the space station will be visible low on the horizon as it travels from Belleville toward Fitchburg at 3:23 AM. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 62 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician for public works projects through September 20th, and residents should note that new sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently approved to keep our essential infrastructure self-supporting.
You have plenty of local options this week, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.
In a notable incident from Friday, August 15th, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after she was discovered unresponsive in her vehicle.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is currently closed and will reopen at 10:00 AM tomorrow.
